# Client Offboarding Checklist

When an engagement ends, I close it out so nothing lingers. Hand over the repositories and the documentation, and agree on a date after which support becomes a new engagement. Revoke the access I was given and remove the credentials from the password manager. Send the final invoice and archive the project folder in `~/files`. Finally, set the client hub to `status: archived` and add a last line to its timeline. Compare with [[client-onboarding-checklist]].
